_comment: Generated by tool/generate_levels.py (edit it there). Each level overrides the base game_config.json: 'stage' uses the same keys as a base stage (missing keys = off), 'speed' / 'size' are pointer deg/s and zone deg at the start, rising per target with speedPerTarget / sizePerTarget. Clearing a level is one star; each of its two 'goals' is another (see lib/game/star_goals.dart). A chapter opens at 'unlockStars' total stars and gives 'reward' once all its levels are cleared.

levels.title: First Lock
levels.teaches: Tap when the pointer is on the zone that matches the ball. The fuse around the ball burns down: don't let the pointer pass the zone.

levels.title: Sweet Spot
levels.teaches: The bright band inside each zone is the Perfect window. Perfects are worth 3, and in a row they raise your combo.

levels.title: Two Colors
levels.teaches: Now there are two colors. Only the one matching the ball counts.

levels.title: Pick the Right One
levels.teaches: Three colors on the ring. Find the ball's color first, then wait for it.

levels.title: Warm-Up Run
levels.teaches: Clear the dots above the ball in a row for a set bonus.

levels.title: About Face
levels.teaches: REVERSE: the pointer flips direction after every hit.

levels.title: Back and Forth
levels.teaches: Sometimes it flips, sometimes it doesn't. Watch the pointer, not the clock.

levels.title: Switchback
levels.teaches: Every hit flips it, with more colors to choose from.

levels.title: Ping Pong
levels.teaches: Short hops back and forth. Stay calm.

levels.title: Turnabout
levels.teaches: Three colors, flips and lock sets together.

levels.title: Greedy
levels.teaches: GREEDY: a thin gold-rimmed zone is worth +5. Go for it, or wait for the safe one.

levels.title: Power-Ups
levels.teaches: Badges ride on targets: hit the target to collect them. Shield, slow-mo and wide.

levels.title: Shield Up
levels.teaches: A shield absorbs one miss. Keep it to the end for a star.

levels.title: Lucky Streak
levels.teaches: Gold zones and power-ups. Greed is good, sometimes.

levels.title: Treasure Hunt
levels.teaches: Everything so far, with gold on top.

levels.title: Not That One
levels.teaches: NOT: the ball shows a crossed-out color. Hit any color EXCEPT that one.

levels.title: Anything But
levels.teaches: NOT rounds now and then. Read the ball before you tap.

levels.title: Mixed Signals
levels.teaches: NOT rounds and flips together.

levels.title: Double Negative
levels.teaches: Four colors, lots of NOTs.

levels.title: Contrary
levels.teaches: NOT, flips and gold zones.

levels.title: Decoys
levels.teaches: DECOYS: a wrong color sits right next to the right one. Tap a little early or late and you lose.

levels.title: Close Call
levels.teaches: Decoys on every round. Aim for the middle.

levels.title: Fakeout
levels.teaches: Decoys and flips.

levels.title: Near Miss
levels.teaches: Decoys with NOT rounds: the wrong color might be the right one.

levels.title: Hall of Mirrors
levels.teaches: Decoys, flips and NOTs together.

levels.title: Carousel
levels.teaches: SPIN: the ring turns too, so zones move while the pointer moves.

levels.title: Merry-Go-Round
levels.teaches: Spinning rings with more colors.

levels.title: Counterspin
levels.teaches: The ring and the pointer don't always turn the same way.

levels.title: Whirl
levels.teaches: Spin and decoys.

levels.title: Tilt-a-Whirl
levels.teaches: Spin, flips and NOTs.

levels.title: Ghosts
levels.teaches: GHOST: zones blink in and out. They always start visible: remember where they are.

levels.title: Now You See It
levels.teaches: More ghosts, more colors.

levels.title: Haunted Carousel
levels.teaches: Spinning ghosts. Watch the ring, not just the pointer.

levels.title: Poltergeist
levels.teaches: Ghosts, flips and decoys.

levels.title: Seance
levels.teaches: Ghosts, NOTs and spin.

levels.title: Two at Once
levels.teaches: SPLIT: the ball is two colors. Hit the left one first, then the right one, in one lap.

levels.title: Split Decision
levels.teaches: Splits that change direction. The second color is always after the first.

levels.title: Double Take
levels.teaches: Splits with four colors.

levels.title: Splitting Hairs
levels.teaches: Splits and decoys.

levels.title: Divide and Conquer
levels.teaches: Splits, NOTs and spin.

levels.title: Fever Pitch
levels.teaches: 5 Perfects in a row starts FEVER: double points and a faster pointer. A Good ends it.

levels.title: Heat Wave
levels.teaches: Every Perfect during Fever scores double. Keep it going.

levels.title: Hot and Cold
levels.teaches: Fever through flips.

levels.title: Wildfire
levels.teaches: Fever on a spinning ring.

levels.title: Inferno
levels.teaches: Fever with decoys and flips.

levels.title: Remember
levels.teaches: BOSS: colors flash in the ball one at a time. Remember them, then hit them in that order.

levels.title: Recall
levels.teaches: Two bosses, with normal rounds between them.

levels.title: Long Memory
levels.teaches: Four colors to remember this time.

levels.title: Boss Rush
levels.teaches: A boss every other round, with NOT rounds in between.

levels.title: Mind Palace
levels.teaches: Long sequences between flips.

levels.title: Steady Hands
levels.teaches: Every 3 Perfects in a row raise your combo multiplier, up to x5. A Good resets it.

levels.title: Rhythm
levels.teaches: Long Perfect streaks on a calm ring.

levels.title: Flow
levels.teaches: Keep the combo going through flips.

levels.title: In the Zone
levels.teaches: Keep the combo going on a spinning ring.

levels.title: Perfectionist
levels.teaches: Nothing but Perfects.

levels.title: Chaos
levels.teaches: Everything you have learned, mixed.

levels.title: Gauntlet
levels.teaches: Longer, with a boss in the middle.

levels.title: Storm
levels.teaches: Fast spins and ghosts.

levels.title: Endgame
levels.teaches: No mercy: decoys, splits and NOTs.

levels.title: Hue Master
levels.teaches: The final test. Three stars here means you have mastered Hue Lock.
